decisions.reason: Because this sweet pastry was no longer observed on the website after 2019 and shows no strong positive signal, it likely fell below aspiration relative to the rest of the range, so its resources would be better redeployed.

This farmhouse bread fits the core bread business and uses existing skills and inputs, so absent clear evidence of underperformance the firm would normally retain it, though overlap with other loaves creates some review risk.
As a flagship seasonal product with a gold award, the poppy seed Christmas stollen appears to exceed aspiration levels and strongly merits continuation.

The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold award and supports the firm's seasonal premium positioning, so it would likely be kept, with only limited risk of portfolio rationalisation against the flagship stollen.
